c-3e9657f4137d4558.texto: See also Luke 23:50. The expression “counselor” means that Joseph was a member of the Jewish Sanhedrim or Great Council. Luke makes this clear by adding, “The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them” (Luke 23:51). “Them” undoubtedly refers to the Jewish authorities…
